# RTO-6 State Model Review

## Summary

The draft lists the burner states, but it does not control the fumes. Three problems need attention first:

1. **Fumes can pass untreated while the state still shows PROCESS.** Nothing diverts the fumes when TT-601 falls below the destruction temperature. The "high fire" rule does not fix this.
2. **Operators open XV-601 directly from the faceplate.** This bypasses the state logic and its permissives. XV-602 is never coordinated with XV-601, so the CL-6 exhaust can be dead-headed or bypassed to stack.
3. **FAULT is a dead end.** "Any trip" is not defined, there are no trip classes, and FAULT has no exit. A low-temperature fume problem and a flame failure get the same response.

## Findings

| ID | Location | Issue | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| F-01 | Whole draft | Setpoints are written in prose (5 min, 760 C, 200 C). | Move all values to the setpoint list (SP-601-xx). Prose references the list only. |
| F-02 | Whole draft | Requirements have no IDs, test methods, initiators, or automation levels. | Add FR-RTO6-NNN IDs and a test method to each transition. |
| F-03 | OFF→PURGE, PURGE→HEAT-UP | Purge is timer-only. Airflow is not proven. There are no start permissives (XV-601 closed, gas safety shutoff valves closed, no active trip). Purge is a BMS function. | BMS performs and proves the purge. BPCS only requests it and monitors it. Purge basis is the BMS vendor's (OI-01). |
| F-04 | HEAT-UP | Ignition is merged into heat-up. There is no ramp-rate limit for the media and refractory, and no timeout. | Add a separate IGNITING state (BMS-owned). Ramp the TIC-601 setpoint. Add a heat-up timeout. |
| F-05 | READY→PROCESS | Operators command a device (XV-601) instead of the state. There are no permissives (CL-6 running, LEL, temperature). XV-602 is not mentioned. | Add an ADMIT FUMES state command that runs a make-before-break sequence. Lock XV-601 and XV-602 faceplates under state control. |
| F-06 | PROCESS, "high fire" rule | This is an open-loop action on a closed-loop variable. Fumes are not diverted below the destruction temperature. It cannot be tested as written ("falls below" has no deadband or delay). | TIC-601 modulates the burner in all firing states. Add an automatic transition to DIVERTING below a divert low limit, with a delay and hysteresis. |
| F-07 | PROCESS exits | The only exit is Stop→COOL-DOWN. A CL-6 stop or high LEL forces a full cool-down and re-purge. | Add PROCESS→DIVERTING→HOT STANDBY. The burner stays lit. |
| F-08 | Any→FAULT | Trips are not defined or classified. FAULT has no actions and no exit. BMS and SIS trips are mixed with BPCS conditions. | Split into two classes: fume-divert causes (BPCS, go to HOT STANDBY) and combustion trips (BMS/SIS, go to TRIPPED). Reference the C&E chart and the SRS. Define reset and exits. |
| F-09 | HEAT-UP, READY | STOP is only accepted in PROCESS. | Accept STOP in every running state. |
| F-10 | COOL-DOWN | Fan behavior is not stated. TT-601 measures the chamber, not the media beds. There is no timeout. | Fan runs and burner is off. Bed temperature criterion is OI-05. Add a timeout. |
| F-11 | Missing | No bad PV, comms loss, power loss/restart, or fail positions. | Add section 7 below. |
| F-12 | Missing | No interface to CL-6 (running signal in, "RTO on-line" permissive out). | Add to the permissives and the sequences. |
| F-13 | Missing | No high solvent load handling (high LEL, chamber over-temperature from fume heat). | Add LEL divert. Add a high-temperature override on TIC-601. Hot-side bypass is OI-06. |
| F-14 | Missing | Regenerative bed switching valves are not in the model. "Combustion fan" may be the burner air blower, not the process fan that moves fumes. | OI-02, OI-03. |
| F-15 | State list | Stable and transient states are not separated. "READY" does not say what is ready. | Use ISA-106 stable/transient types. Rename READY to HOT STANDBY. |
| F-16 | All transitions | No timeouts or failure responses. | Sequence tables in section 4. |
| F-17 | Missing | No operator prompts. No operations sign-off. | Section 8, OI-11. |

---

## Corrected state model

### 1. Setpoint list (draft)

Values from the draft are kept for traceability. All values need confirmation.

| SP ID | Description | Draft value | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| SP-601-01 | Purge basis (volume changes at proven airflow) | Draft said 5 min; replace with volume basis | BMS vendor, OI-01 |
| SP-601-02 | Fume admission permissive, TT-601 | 760 °C | Permit / RTO vendor |
| SP-601-03 | Fume divert low limit, TT-601 (below SP-601-02) | TBD | OI-04 |
| SP-601-04 | TIC-601 operating setpoint | TBD | OI-04 |
| SP-601-05 | Cool-down complete, TT-601 | 200 °C | RTO vendor |
| SP-601-06 | Heat-up ramp rate, maximum | TBD | Media vendor |
| SP-601-07 | Heat-up timeout | TBD | OI-04 |
| SP-601-08 | XV-601 / XV-602 stroke timeout | TBD | Valve data |
| SP-601-09 | Inlet LEL divert limit | TBD | Process safety |
| SP-601-10 | High-temperature override, TT-601 | TBD | RTO vendor |
| SP-601-11 | Cool-down timeout | TBD | OI-04 |
| SP-601-12 | Low-temperature divert delay | TBD | OI-04 |

### 2. States

Stable states hold indefinitely. Transient states end on completion, timeout, or trip.

| State | Type | Burner | Fan | XV-601 | XV-602 | Allowed exits |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| OFF | Stable | Off, SSOVs closed | Off | Closed | Open | PURGING |
| PURGING | Transient | Off | Run | Closed | Open | IGNITING, COOLING, TRIPPED |
| IGNITING | Transient (BMS) | Trial for ignition | Run | Closed | Open | HEATING, TRIPPED |
| HEATING | Transient | TIC-601, ramped SP | Run | Closed | Open | HOT STANDBY, COOLING, TRIPPED |
| HOT STANDBY | Stable | TIC-601 at SP-601-04 | Run | Closed | Open | ADMITTING, COOLING, TRIPPED |
| ADMITTING | Transient | TIC-601 | Run | Opening | Closing | PROCESS, HOT STANDBY, TRIPPED |
| PROCESS | Stable | TIC-601 | Run | Open | Closed | DIVERTING, TRIPPED |
| DIVERTING | Transient | TIC-601 | Run | Closing | Opening | HOT STANDBY, COOLING, TRIPPED |
| COOLING | Transient | Off | Run | Closed | Open | OFF, PURGING, TRIPPED |
| TRIPPED | Stable | Off (BMS) | Run if available | Closed | Open | PURGING, COOLING (after reset) |

**FR-RTO6-001:** No state lights the burner without a completed BMS purge. Every path to IGNITING goes through PURGING. *Test: FAT, attempt START from each state.*

### 3. Transitions

| ID | From → To | Initiator | Condition / permissives | Automation | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-RTO6-010 | OFF → PURGING | Operator START | No active trip; XV-601 proven closed; XV-602 proven open; BMS ready; fan available | Operator-initiated, automatic | FAT: defeat each permissive in turn |
| FR-RTO6-011 | PURGING → IGNITING | Auto | BMS "purge complete" per SP-601-01 | Automatic | FAT: BMS simulation |
| FR-RTO6-012 | IGNITING → HEATING | Auto | BMS "main flame proven" | Automatic | FAT: BMS simulation |
| FR-RTO6-013 | HEATING → HOT STANDBY | Auto | TT-601 at or above SP-601-02 | Automatic | FAT: ramp simulated PV |
| FR-RTO6-014 | HEATING → TRIPPED | Auto | Time in HEATING exceeds SP-601-07 | Automatic | FAT: hold PV low |
| FR-RTO6-015 | HOT STANDBY → ADMITTING | Operator ADMIT FUMES | TT-601 at or above SP-601-02; CL-6 exhaust running; LEL below SP-601-09; no divert cause active; bed switching normal | Operator-prompted | FAT: defeat each permissive |
| FR-RTO6-016 | ADMITTING → PROCESS | Auto | Admission sequence complete | Automatic | FAT |
| FR-RTO6-017 | PROCESS → DIVERTING | Auto or operator DIVERT/STOP | Any divert cause in the C&E chart (low temperature per SP-601-03 and SP-601-12, high LEL, CL-6 stopped, valve discrepancy, bad PV) | Automatic | FAT: each cause |
| FR-RTO6-018 | DIVERTING → HOT STANDBY | Auto | Divert sequence complete; no STOP latched | Automatic | FAT |
| FR-RTO6-019 | DIVERTING → COOLING | Auto | Divert sequence complete; STOP latched | Automatic | FAT |
| FR-RTO6-020 | PURGING / HEATING / HOT STANDBY → COOLING | Operator STOP | None | Operator-initiated | FAT |
| FR-RTO6-021 | COOLING → OFF | Auto | TT-601 below SP-601-05 (plus bed criterion, OI-05); then fan stops | Automatic | FAT |
| FR-RTO6-022 | COOLING → TRIPPED | Auto | Time in COOLING exceeds SP-601-11 | Automatic | FAT |
| FR-RTO6-023 | COOLING → PURGING | Operator START | Same permissives as FR-RTO6-010 | Operator-initiated | FAT |
| FR-RTO6-024 | Any running state → TRIPPED | Auto | Any combustion trip in the C&E chart or the SRS | Automatic | FAT: each trip input |
| FR-RTO6-025 | TRIPPED → PURGING / COOLING | Operator RESET, then START or STOP | All trip causes clear | Operator-initiated | FAT |

### 4. Sequences

**ADMITTING (make-before-break)**: FR-RTO6-030

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Check FR-RTO6-015 permissives. | All permissives true | None (immediate) | Go to HOT STANDBY. Show the failed permissive. |
| 2 | Open XV-601. | XV-601 open limit on, closed limit off | SP-601-08 | Close XV-601. Go to HOT STANDBY. Alarm. |
| 3 | Close XV-602. | XV-602 closed limit on, open limit off | SP-601-08 | Open XV-602. Close XV-601. Go to HOT STANDBY. Alarm. |
| 4 | Send "RTO-6 on-line" to CL-6. Stop the bypass event record. | Signal sent | None | None. |

**DIVERTING (make-before-break)**: FR-RTO6-031

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Open XV-602. | XV-602 open limit on | SP-601-08 | Keep XV-601 open. Request CL-6 stop per the C&E chart. Alarm. Go to step 2 after CL-6 stops. |
| 2 | Close XV-601. | XV-601 closed limit on | SP-601-08 | Request CL-6 stop per the C&E chart. Alarm. Hold, and prompt the operator. |
| 3 | Remove "RTO-6 on-line" from CL-6. Start the bypass event record. | Signal removed | None | None. |

Step order prevents dead-heading the CL-6 exhaust duct. Duct pressure control during transfer is OI-02.

### 5. Regulatory control: TIC-601

- **PV:** TT-601. **Output:** firing-rate demand to the BMS. **Action:** reverse (output increases as PV decreases).
- **HEATING:** Auto. The setpoint ramps from current PV to SP-601-04 at SP-601-06. *(FR-RTO6-040)*
- **HOT STANDBY, ADMITTING, PROCESS, DIVERTING:** Auto at SP-601-04. *(FR-RTO6-041)*
- **High-temperature override:** If TT-601 is above SP-601-10, the output goes to minimum fire. *(FR-RTO6-042)*
- **OFF, PURGING, IGNITING, COOLING, TRIPPED:** The output tracks the BMS position. Auto is blocked. *(FR-RTO6-043)*
- **Manual:** Allowed in any firing state. The BMS limits apply. Manual mode does not inhibit any divert cause. *(FR-RTO6-044)*
- **Remove** the "high fire" statement.

No tuning values in this document.

### 6. Interlocks and SIS

- Divert causes and combustion trips are defined in the RTO-6 C&E chart (OI-10). This narrative does not restate them.
- Flame supervision, gas train, combustion air proof, high-temperature limit, and purge are BMS/SIS functions. They are specified in the SRS and the BMS functional spec, not here.
- Alarms are defined in the rationalized alarm database. This includes the "bypass active while CL-6 running" alarm.

### 7. Abnormal handling

| ID | Condition | Response |
|---|---|---|
| FR-RTO6-050 | TT-601 bad PV | Block admission. In PROCESS, go to DIVERTING. TIC-601 goes to manual at the last good output. The BMS high limit stays active. |
| FR-RTO6-051 | LEL bad PV | Block admission. In PROCESS, go to DIVERTING. |
| FR-RTO6-052 | BPCS–BMS comms loss | Block admission. In PROCESS, go to DIVERTING. BMS response is per the BMS spec (OI-09). |
| FR-RTO6-053 | BPCS–CL-6 comms loss | Stay in PROCESS. Alarm. Block new admission. |
| FR-RTO6-054 | Fail positions | XV-601 fails closed. XV-602 fails open. Gas SSOVs fail closed. Confirm against the valve data. |
| FR-RTO6-055 | Power loss and restore | On restore, RTO-6 enters TRIPPED. No automatic restart. A purge is mandatory. Fan auto-restart for media protection is OI-07. |
| FR-RTO6-056 | Instrument air loss | Valves go to fail positions. State response is OI-12. |

### 8. Operator interface

- **State commands:** START, STOP, ADMIT FUMES, DIVERT FUMES, RESET. *(FR-RTO6-060)*
- **XV-601 and XV-602 faceplates:** No operator open/close commands outside OFF with maintenance mode active. *(FR-RTO6-061)*
- **Display:** current state, time in state, the next permissive, failed permissives, and a bypass-active indicator with its duration. *(FR-RTO6-062)*
- **Prompt in HOT STANDBY when CL-6 runs:** "RTO-6 is at temperature. CL-6 is running. Push ADMIT FUMES." *(FR-RTO6-063)*
